chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr who said:
I asked Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) about the two rak'ahs of Fajr, so he said: 'Fill them with the night prayer.'

key_terms.رَكْعَتَا الْفَجْرِ: The two voluntary rak'ahs of the Fajr prayer

ai.seo_question: How should the two rak'ahs of Fajr be performed in relation to the night prayer according to Imam al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) instructed that the two voluntary rak'ahs of the Fajr prayer should be combined with or considered part of the night prayer (salat al-layl), effectively treating them as the completion or essence of the night prayer. This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly preference for consolidating voluntary prayers to maximize spiritual focus and aligns with the practice of the Ahl al-Bayt, who often viewed the Fajr sunnah as an extension of the Qiyam al-Layl rather than a separate entity. Such consolidation underscores the importance of continuity in worship and the flexibility within Shia fiqh to merge related acts of devotion for greater devotion.
